statements.t: In 2026, we expect store week growth of 5.0% to 5.5%, including the benefit from franchise acquisitions.
In 2027, we expect store week growth of 5.0% to 6.0% across all concepts.
In 2026, we expect commodity inflation of approximately 5.0%, with prices locked for approximately 80% of our remaining forecasted costs and the remainder subject to floating market prices.
In 2027, we expect commodity inflation of approximately 4.0%.
In 2026, we expect wage and other labor inflation of 3.5% to 4.0%.
In 2027, we expect wage and other labor inflation of approximately 3.0%.
In 2026, we expect an effective tax rate of approximately 13.0% based on forecasted operating results.
In 2027, we expect an effective tax rate of approximately 13.0% based on forecasted operating results.
We intend to satisfy our capital requirements over the next 12 months with cash on hand, net cash provided by operating activities and, if needed, funds available under our revolving credit facility.
In 2026, we expect capital expenditures of approximately $440 million.
In 2027, we expect capital expenditures of approximately $425 million.
We are confident that their commitment to the overall guest experience will continue to differentiate us, particularly as consumers navigate rising costs.”
The call will be webcast live from the investor relations portion of the Company’s website at investor.texasroadhouse.com.
A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website shortly after the conclusion of the call.

labor or supply chain shortages or limited availability of staff or product needed to meet the Company’s business standards
changes in consumer discretionary spending and macroeconomic conditions, including inflationary pressures and the impact of tariffs
food safety and food-borne illness concerns
other factors disclosed from time to time in the Company’s filings with the U.S
